restaurants.name: Bouillon Chartier
restaurants.desc: A huge Belle Époque dining hall serving cheap French classics since 1896. No reservations, so expect a short line.

restaurants.name: Le Procope
restaurants.desc: Opened in 1686 and often called the oldest café in Paris. Known for coq au vin and its history with Voltaire and Benjamin Franklin.

restaurants.name: Chez Janou
restaurants.desc: A lively bistro near Place des Vosges with southern French cooking, a long pastis list and a famous chocolate mousse.

restaurants.name: Le Train Bleu
restaurants.desc: A painted, gilded dining room inside the Gare de Lyon station, open since 1901. Worth it even just for a drink in the bar.

restaurants.name: Septime
restaurants.desc: A Michelin-starred neighborhood spot with seasonal tasting menus. Tables open online and go fast, so book weeks ahead.

fundraisers.name: Copperhill Flood Emergency Fund
fundraisers.org: United Way of the Ocoee Region
fundraisers.desc: Helps families and businesses in Copperhill, Tennessee recover from the historic November 4–5 floods.

fundraisers.name: Green Acres Learjet Crash Fund
fundraisers.desc: Direct financial help for residents forced to leave their homes after the November 1 crash at Green Acres Mobile Home Community.

fundraisers.name: World Central Kitchen
fundraisers.desc: Chef José Andrés's nonprofit that cooks fresh meals for people hit by disasters and crises around the world.

fundraisers.name: Doctors Without Borders
fundraisers.desc: Independent medical teams working in conflict zones, epidemics and disasters in more than 70 countries.

fundraisers.name: Direct Relief
fundraisers.desc: Sends medicine and medical supplies to health workers after disasters and in communities with little access to care.
